# Words to add on top of the nep_dict source, one per line, Devanagari only.
#
# The source dictionary is a lexicon rather than a word list, so it is missing
# things a typist needs — proper nouns (नेपाल is not in it), and ordinary words
# it simply skipped. Adding them here rather than editing the generated files
# means they survive the next `python tools/mkwords.py`.
#
# Latin keys are derived by the same schema inversion as everything else, and
# -नु verbs get their inflections generated, so an entry here behaves exactly
# like one that came from the source.

टाढा
ढाल्नु

# Very common words the source lexicon omits. गर्नु is the commonest verb in
# the language; the proper nouns were never going to be in a dictionary.
गर्नु
सक्नु
नेपाल
काठमाडौं
भारत
चीन
उनी
तपाईं
त्यो
अहिले
अघि
सधैं
तर
वा
कि
नराम्रो
ठूलो
नयाँ
धेरै

# Pronoun forms and verbs the source omits.
मैले
उ
चल्नु
